GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS AND
  EFFICIENCY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 21, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:30 PM

Kristina Duggan, Chair
Dr. Joni Ricks-Oddie, Vice Chair
Mary Zendejas, Member

  Members of the public have the option to submit online public comments and email
  comments to cityclerk@longbeach.gov

  Please view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone via:
  https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  26-54916  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Government Operations and
  Efficiency Committee meeting of Tuesday, March 10, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  26-54917  Recommendation to approve and refer back to City Council for consideration and
  approval, the naming of the Central Facilities Center at Martin Luther King Park to
  the "Dale Clinton Facilities Center", in accordance with City of Long Beach
  Administrative Regulation AR 8-7 facility naming process.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  26-54918  Recommendation to approve and refer back to City Council for consideration and
  approval, the naming of the Los Altos Plaza Park to "Park Estates Community
  Park", in accordance with City of Long Beach Administrative Regulation AR 8-7
  facility naming process.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  26-54919  Recommendation to receive and discuss the staff memorandum providing
  feedback and recommendations on the Framework for Accountability, Integrity,
  and Reporting (FAIR Act), provide staff with input, and make recommendations to
  City Council, as appropriate.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Mary Zendejas, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

 CALL TO ORDER

 A 3:41 PM, Chair Duggan called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Councilmembers Present: Zendejas, Ricks-Oddie, Duggan

 Also present: Erin Weesner-McKinley, Principal Deputy City Attorney, Jonathan Nagayama, City
 Clerk Analyst.

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  26-54916  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Government Operations and
  Efficiency Committee meeting of Tuesday, March 10, 2026.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Ricks-Oddie, seconded by Member
  Zendejas, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  3  Zendejas, Ricks-Oddie, Duggan
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

 2.  26-54917  Recommendation to approve and refer back to City Council for consideration and
  approval, the naming of the Central Facilities Center at Martin Luther King Park to
  the "Dale Clinton Facilities Center", in accordance with City of Long Beach
  Administrative Regulation AR 8-7 facility naming process.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Ricks-Oddie, seconded by Member
  Zendejas, to approve and refer back to City Council for consideration and
  approval, the naming of the Central Facilities Center at Martin Luther King
  Park to the "Dale E. Clinton Resource Center", in accordance with City of

3.  26-54918  Recommendation to approve and refer back to City Council for consideration and
  approval, the naming of the Los Altos Plaza Park to "Park Estates Community
  Park", in accordance with City of Long Beach Administrative Regulation AR 8-7
  facility naming process.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Ricks-Oddie, seconded by Member
  Zendejas, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  3  Zendejas, Ricks-Oddie, Duggan
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

4.  26-54919  Recommendation to receive and discuss the staff memorandum providing
  feedback and recommendations on the Framework for Accountability, Integrity,
  and Reporting (FAIR Act), provide staff with input, and make recommendations to
  City Council, as appropriate.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Ricks-Oddie, seconded by Member
  Zendejas, to approve recommendation, as amended, to bring the full draft to
  the City Council in a study session, with a position of support from the
  committee around using a calendar tracking mechanism to address the larger
  component in relation to lobbying with a to be determined method
  implementing the calendaring. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Zendejas, Ricks-Oddie, Duggan
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Tyler Curley, Deputy City Manager, spoke.
